title_fa: اجرای گرافیکی: ONNX روی کارت گرافیک (DirectML)، OpenCV، Pillow
note: The same small environment the photo-matting package uses (venvs/matting) so nothing is installed twice and nothing of the owner's Python is touched. onnxruntime-directml runs the matting / RVM models on any DirectX 12 GPU without CUDA DLLs; edit_rvm.py and photo_matting.py already prefer a Python whose onnxruntime has a GPU provider.
